title: Agency Standard Operating Procedures (SOP)
content:
# ExtrovertNerd Agency SOP

1. Run daily prospecting bot targeting local businesses with sub-40 mobile scores.
2. Dispatch 4-slide before/after carousels to Instagram and X.
3. Send 1-click WhatsApp speed audit audits within 15 minutes of response.
4. Deliver 100/100 Core Web Vitals guarantees on all custom Laravel builds.

title: Laravel 11 Sub-Second Performance Blueprint
content:
# Performance Architecture Checklist

- Redis full-page response cache (TTFB < 150ms)
- Inline Tailwind critical CSS + Alpine.js zero-bloat reactivity
- AVIF/WebP image pipeline via Intervention Image
- Zero unminified third-party analytics trackers in head tag.
